pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-scale polygonal dark regions with soft-edged pixel gradients and moderate angularity; spatial area is relatively uniform across the central flank with transition to smaller, denser units on the forelimb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned pathways forming a connected graph; junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial with a pixel thickness of approximately 8-12 pixels throughout the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated mane profile along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, showing a distinct dark fringe against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark, elongated pixel cluster is perched on the upper shoulder ridge, indicative of an oxpecker bird.
